title: Affine chart coordinates for the base change map
statement: Let f : X → S be an affine morphism, let f' : X' → S', g : S' → S and g' : X' → X form a cartesian square, and let F be a quasi-coherent O_X-module. For affine opens U of S and W of S' with W ⊆ g⁻¹(U), put R = Γ(S,U), B = Γ(X,f⁻¹(U)), R' = Γ(S',W) and M = Γ(F,f⁻¹(U)), with the algebra and module structures induced by f and g. There exist R'-linear equivalences a : Γ(g* f_*F,W) ≃ R' ⊗_R M and b : Γ(f'_* g'*F,W) ≃ (R' ⊗_R B) ⊗_B M such that b(beta_W(a⁻¹(r ⊗ m))) = (r ⊗ 1) ⊗ m for every r in R' and m in M, where beta is the canonical module base-change map.

proof.text: Restrict to compatible affine opens and identify them with spectra of their section rings. The cartesian square identifies the pulled-back affine with the tensor product ring, and quasi-coherence identifies the module with the associated module of sections.

Apply exists_affineBaseChange_tensorComparisons after the affine and tilde identifications. The open-restriction comparison transports beta to this square. The adjunction identity homEquiv(homEquiv.symm(k)) = k identifies beta after the g-unit with the pushforward of the g'-unit; the sectionwise pushforward composition identifications are identities. The two unit-normalized tensor comparisons give the formula at 1 tensor m, and R'-linearity gives it at r tensor m. This proves only the coordinate formula, without using bijectivity of beta.

theorem exists_affineBaseChange_chart_coordinates {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffineHom f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (W : S'.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hWU : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    let R := Γ(S, U)
    let B := Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    let R' := Γ(S', W)
    let M := Γ(F, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    letI : Algebra R B := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R R' := (g.appLE U W hWU).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M (f.app U).hom
    letI : Algebra B (R' ⊗[R] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ∃ (a : Γ((tensorPullback g).obj ((pushforward f).obj F), W) ≃ₗ[R'] R' ⊗[R] M)
      (b : Γ((pushforward f').obj ((tensorPullback g').obj F), W) ≃ₗ[R']
        (R' ⊗[R] B) ⊗[B] M),
      ∀ (r : R') (m : M),
        b ((moduleBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w F).app W (a.symm (r ⊗ₜ[R] m))) =
          (r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) ⊗ₜ[B] m
